definitions: A raspberry (noise made to imitate flatulence).
An emission of a rapid stream of bubbles.
The sound of such an emission.
To make a rapid hissing or bubbling sound.

blocks.text: A raspberry, or razz, also known as a Bronx cheer, is a mouth noise similar to a fart that is used to signify derision. It is also used as a voice exercise for singers and actors, where it may be called a raspberry trill or tongue trill. It is made by placing the tongue between the lips and blowing, so that the tongue trills against the lower lip.

Effervescence is the escape of gas from an aqueous solution and the foaming or fizzing that results from that release. The word effervescence is derived from the Latin verb fervere, preceded by the prefix ex. It has the same linguistic root as the word fermentation.
